title: Trent's reforms
hookLine: seminaries, a catechism, and a Mass book that lasted four hundred years

cards: A decree is only ink until somebody carries it out.
The bishops at Trent could settle grace and scripture on paper, but a village priest who had never been trained would still stand at the altar on Sunday and do what he had always done.
So the council turned from doctrine to plumbing. Who teaches the priests? What book do they teach from?
Which words does the Mass use? Today's word is the name that stuck to the answers: Tridentine.

teach.b: Tridentine simply means: of Trent. It got attached to three things. First, the seminary.
Trent asked each diocese to keep a college where boys and young men preparing for the priesthood would live, pray and study together, learning scripture, the sacraments and how to care for souls.
Formation became a place with a timetable. Second, the catechism.
The council called for a book that pastors could teach from, and after it closed, one was published in Rome: the Roman Catechism, sometimes called the Catechism of the Council of Trent.
It was written for priests, so that what they preached on Sunday matched what the council had taught. Third, the Missal.

teach.h: ONE MISSAL FOR THE LATIN CHURCH.
teach.b: The council left the reform of the Mass book to the pope, and Pope Pius the Fifth issued a Roman Missal for the Latin Church. That Mass, in Latin, is what people mean today by the Tridentine Mass.
Four hundred years is the round number people give for how long the book shaped the Sunday of Latin Catholics, until the reforms after the Second Vatican Council.

Some Catholics still celebrate it, and the Church has set rules for when and where. Underneath all three is one idea. Jesus said, in the Douay-Rheims, "The harvest indeed is great, but the labourers are few."
Trent's answer was not only to pray for laborers, but to train them.

how: Catholic parishes pray for vocations, often in the Prayer of the Faithful at Mass, and dioceses keep or share a seminary where future priests live and study before ordination.

games.q: you're a bishop at Trent. the doctrine is settled on paper, but your village priests were never trained. what do you do?
o: send each priest a copy of the decrees and hope.

games.why: Trent asked each diocese to keep a seminary, so formation became a place with a timetable.

practice: Somewhere tonight, in a seminary, young men are eating dinner, studying, wondering whether they're meant for this; keep them in mind, and if you know a seminarian, or a priest who was one, hold his face.

If you pray, use the line Jesus gave right after the one about the harvest: "Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he send forth labourers into his harvest." If you don't pray, simply wish them good teachers.
